This is the original printed text (version 1 of 2). The current text is [[Vigo (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee Set 0 master sheet<ref name="eh1362-vi-0">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 6 August 2016.</ref>. Dated by 6 August 2016 (the earliest preserved copy of the Players Committee Set 0 master sheet, which gives the set's release as 24 September 2014); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Vigo (V) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} The PC card image with the same words is in the Holotable repository by 8 July 2018 (commit 022435b). Text: “Deploys -1 to Coruscant. While present with Xizor, forfeit +2 and opponents spies may not deploy to same non-battleground site. Once per game, may use 1 Force to ▼ a non-war room battleground planet site (or system) not already on table.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Vigo (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1362-vi-1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/vigo.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The PC re-made the image at higher resolution (354×492 → 745×1039 pixels). Text: “Deploys -1 to Coruscant. While present with Xizor, forfeit +2 and opponent's spies may not deploy to same non-battleground site. Once per game, may use 1 Force to ▼ a non-war room battleground planet site (or system) not already on table.” '''What changed:''' game text: “opponents spies” → “opponent's spies”; the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. No errata mark. Before/after (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-vigo-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] → [[File:V0-D-vigo-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]]. This is change 1 in release order, so the missing mark is listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). This is the current text.
